withdrawal.entry_hint: Withdraw your membership. We'll explain exactly what happens.
withdrawal.ack_body:
We understand. Here is exactly what happens if you withdraw:

• Your ₹110 Vyawastha Shulk will not be refunded.
• Your contribution history stays on record, and is anonymised later.
• You will not be able to rejoin under the same identity for 12 months.

Take your time. Nothing happens until you confirm.
withdrawal.reason_title: If you'd like, tell us why
withdrawal.reason_intro: This is optional. It helps us understand — you can withdraw without giving a reason.
withdrawal.reason_placeholder: Anything else you'd like to share (optional)
withdrawal.confirm_body: When you confirm, your membership ends: the ₹110 is forfeited, your history is retained then anonymised, and rejoining under the same identity is paused for 12 months.

withdrawal.error_generic: We couldn't complete your withdrawal just now. Please try again in a little while.
withdrawal.rejoin_locked_body: This identity withdrew on {withdrawnDate}. You may rejoin on or after {rejoinDate}.
rtbf.entry_hint: Permanently anonymise the personal details we hold. Your contribution history stays on record, without your name.
rtbf.ack_body:
This is your Right to be Forgotten. Here is exactly what happens:

• Your name, contact details and other personal information are permanently anonymised.
• Your contribution history stays on record as “an anonymous member”, so the trust's accounts remain complete.
• This cannot be undone.

Take your time. Nothing happens until you confirm.
rtbf.confirm_body: When you confirm, your personal details are permanently anonymised. This cannot be undone.
